tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals: row text, titles, the big number. 21:1 on system-background.

tokens.name: secondary-label
tokens.usage: Subtitles, dates, units, row detail, inactive tab items, Slip text and its − mark. Apple's value: 3.4:1 on white in light, below 4.5:1 and kept as Apple ships it; 6.4:1 on black in dark.

tokens.name: tertiary-label
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in a field and the disclosure chevron. Apple's value, 1.7:1: never for content.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: The hairline between rows, inset to the left edge of the row's text. Decorative.

tokens.name: system-background
tokens.usage: The page behind plain lists (Notes, Weight, Coach), the navigation bar and the tab bar.

tokens.name: grouped-background
tokens.usage: The page behind an inset grouped list (Profile).

tokens.name: grouped-cell
tokens.usage: A cell of an inset grouped list, on grouped-background.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: A row while pressed.

tokens.name: tertiary-fill
tokens.usage: The segmented control's track.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control, with shadow-segment.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The one accent: text buttons, the prominent button fill, the selected tab, links, the weight line on the graph, my chat bubble. Apple's blue: 4.0:1 on white in light, kept as Apple ships it; 5.8:1 on black in dark.

tokens.name: tint-soft
tokens.usage: The tinted button's fill, tint text on it.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text on a tint fill: the prominent button's label and my chat bubble. Apple's own pair: 4.0:1 light, 3.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: systemRed: the dashed goal line on the weight graph and a destructive action (Delete). Never for Edit, never for a Slip. 3.6:1 on white light, 6.2:1 on black dark, Apple's values.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: The coach's chat bubble, label text on it (17.7:1 light, 15.5:1 dark).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Hiragino Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The system font at iOS text-style sizes: SF Pro for Latin and digits, Hiragino Sans for Japanese, nothing downloaded. Numerals are tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The screen title in the navigation bar, and the big number of a Stat with tabular figures.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: A section heading inside a screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Emphasised row text and the bold action in a navigation bar.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row text, entries, chat, fields and buttons. The default.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: A row's second line: the extracted exercise numbers, with tabular figures.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Day headers in a list, group headers and footers, units, a Stat's label.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: The label under a tab bar icon.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: A value to its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; inside a chat bubble vertically.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a mark and the text in a row; inside a chat bubble horizontally.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between stats.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A prominent button's horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a day header or a group header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: The layout margin: content, separators and inset groups are inset this much from the screen edge.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: The minimum row height and tap target.

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: The navigation bar's compact height; the large title adds 52px beneath it.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: The tab bar, above the home indicator inset.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: The segmented control's track; 7px on its selected segment.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Inset grouped lists.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Prominent and tinted buttons.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Filter pills.

tokens.name: stroke-separator
tokens.usage: Row separators and bar borders: a hairline on a Retina screen.

tokens.name: stroke-plot
tokens.usage: The weight line and the dashed goal line on the graph.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: Under the selected segment of a segmented control. The only shadow.
